title: DEA test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of DEA registration number candidates paired with category labels and validation verdicts. Designed to exercise the DEA position-weighted checksum algorithm in downstream Swift tests.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one DEA candidate with its expected classification.

dea.description: DEA candidate. Length is category-dependent: 9 chars for most categories, other lengths for invalid_length.

valid.description: Whether the DEA passes all structural checks (two-letter prefix, seven digits, checksum match).

category.description: Which detector edge case this vector exercises.

prefix.description: The two-letter prefix portion of the candidate (first two characters), or a best-effort slice for non-conforming lengths.

expected_check_digit.description: The check digit computed from the first six digits. Matches the last digit of valid rows; differs for invalid_checksum rows.

reason.description: Human note describing why this vector was included.
